description: A design that cannot discriminate the hypothesis from its negation is a blocker.

inputs.label: Method
inputs.content:
H1: Class-specialized teachers improve knowledge transfer BECAUSE specialization
reduces gradient conflict between clients.

Methodology: We train FedSpec on CIFAR-10 and measure final global model top-1
accuracy. We compare against FedAvg accuracy. We do not measure gradient conflict,
gradient alignment, or any intermediate quantity. We run one configuration.

signals.name: identifies that the proposed mechanism is never measured
states the design cannot test the hypothesis as stated
